description: Your family of 5 in Marietta GA is replacing a 2018 Honda CR-V (68,000 miles, trade-in ~$18,000). Research at least 4 specific 2024 or 2025 model-year 3-row SUVs. Save your comparison as a new Apple Notes note covering: each model's base MSRP and typical transaction price, towing capacity and third-row cargo space, ADAS features, reliability rating with source, lumbar support notes by trim level, nearest dealer to Marietta GA, and monthly payment at 6.9% APR 60 months after $18,000 trade-in.
